GmUi.pageScheduleBlurb: Real NBA tips for your franchise, with home and away marked on the calendar.
GmUi.pagePlayInBlurb: The 7 seed hosts the 8. The 9 seed hosts the 10. The last game fills the 8 seed.
GmUi.pagePlayoffsBlurb: The bracket is the schedule. Simulate a night and the scores land on the series.
GmUi.pageNightBlurb: Each block is two minutes. Tap a lit block to sit that player. The next man steps in. Tap an empty block to send someone in, and the lightest minute load sits.
GmUi.pageMedicalBlurb: Trainer level {level}/5 shortens recoveries and lowers game injury risk.
GmUi.pageLineupBlurb: Set how many men play, then auto-balance or drag minutes. A balanced 240 near 48 per spot gives a small sim bump. Primary recomputes OVR; secondary is the other spot he can cover cleanly. Stretching past both costs a little on the night.
GmUi.pageTeamsBlurb: All {count} clubs. Open a team to sort that roster on the players list.
GmUi.pageCapBlurb: Payroll, cap room, tax and aprons, and every contract on the roster.
GmUi.pageStandingsBlurb: Record, win percentage, and point differential for every club in your league.
GmUi.pageTransactionsBlurb: Trades you have offered, and the wire for signings and deals around the league.
GmUi.pageOffseasonBlurb: Playoffs, draft, free agency, then the next season. Each step waits until you advance it.
GmUi.pagePlayersBlurb: Players already in the league, plus free agents. Prospects stay on the draft board. {note} Scout is a range, not the true ceiling.
GmUi.pageGameBlurb: Shot chart, the shifts that tipped off, and the full box for both clubs.
GmUi.playersStatNoteSim: WAR1 is their DRBL/100 times possessions played in this save. Counting stats follow those games.
GmUi.playersStatNoteNoSim: No games yet this save. WAR1, DRBL/100, and the counting columns are the season they entered with.
GmUi.gmPlayerMissing: That player is not in this league.
GmUi.medicalInjuryLine: {type} · {games, plural, one {# game} other {# games}} · re-injury risk {risk}%
GmUi.capRosterIllegal: Roster is short or over the limit.
GmUi.capMleOpen: Mid-level left ${mle}M of ${mleMax}M. Taxpayer mid-level left ${taxMle}M. Bi-annual ${bae}M is open. Minimum ${min}M.
GmUi.capMleUsed: Mid-level left ${mle}M of ${mleMax}M. Taxpayer mid-level left ${taxMle}M. Bi-annual ${bae}M is used. Minimum ${min}M.
GmUi.capStaff: Staff ${staff}M of a ${budget}M owner budget. Coaches are not a cap charge.
GmUi.capDeadMoneyRow: {label}: ${amount}M for {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}}
GmUi.txWireEmpty: Signings and trades land here once the league starts moving.
GmUi.nightNoGame: No game left on the slate.
GmUi.nightPlanLocked: This plan is the one that tips off.
GmUi.nightPlanAuto: The chart is still the automatic rotation. A tap locks your version in.
GmUi.nightSystemsLink: Systems live on the coaching page.
GmUi.coachSizeNote: Changing the size rebuilds the 240-minute book. Auto-balance does the same without touching starters.
GmUi.hubReviewBlurb: Record and FO briefings from the year just played.
GmUi.hubRosterBlurb: Options, waives, and extensions for the 15-man board.
GmUi.hubStaffBlurb: Hire a director of scouting. Their eye + expertise set draft fog.
GmUi.hubDraftBlurb: Codenames, dossiers, and pick-night identity reveals.
GmUi.hubAwardsBlurb: MVP, defense, rookies, sixth man, and the All-NBA teams.
GmUi.hubFaBlurb: Moratorium pitches, Bird re-signs, then open signing and fill.
GmUi.hubCapBlurb: Era salary cap, tax, and aprons from the CBA registry.
GmUi.hubAutoFa: Run the FA clock when free agency opens
GmUi.hubSwitchNote: Off by default. Also on Staff. Your own focuses still dig a little deeper.
GmUi.hubDeadline: The trade deadline has passed. Deals wait until the offseason.
GmUi.hubCapByYearBlurb: Official cap / tax (and aprons when they exist) for each season.
GmUi.gameWatchNote: The game plays out on the court. Pause it, or run it at 2× or 4×. The box score is underneath.
GmUi.gameReplayNote: Every field goal from this box, replayed on the court.
GmUi.gameShiftsNote: Lit blocks are the plan. The number is the minutes that came back in the box.

LearnPages.war1ZeroBody: zero is an average player, so a roster whose players add up to about 0 WAR1 has played like a 40-win team. Each WAR1 has lined up with about 1.3 real wins. Team WAR1 totals are not a prediction of standings wins.
LearnPages.bodyEnglishNote: This article is shown in English. Translated copy for your language is still being added.
LearnPages.contentGapNote: Article bodies load from locale files at src/content/learn/locales/<locale>/topics/<slug>.json and fall back to the English modules in src/content/learn when a locale has no file yet. Chrome on these routes is translated. Guides and the long TSX pages at /learn/drbl and /learn/salary are still English.

El cuerpo de los artículos se carga desde archivos por idioma en src/content/learn/locales/<locale>/topics/<slug>.json y vuelve a los módulos en inglés de src/content/learn cuando un idioma aún no tiene archivo. La interfaz de estas rutas está traducida. Las guías y las páginas largas en TSX de /learn/drbl y /learn/salary siguen en inglés.
LearnPages.war1ZeroBody: el cero es un jugador promedio, así que una plantilla cuyos jugadores suman cerca de 0 WAR1 ha jugado como un equipo de 40 victorias. Cada WAR1 ha equivalido a unas 1,3 victorias reales. Los totales de WAR1 de un equipo no predicen las victorias en la clasificación.
LearnPages.bodyEnglishNote: Este artículo se muestra en inglés. Todavía se está añadiendo la traducción a tu idioma.

LearnPages.contentGapNote: Le corps des articles se charge depuis des fichiers par langue dans src/content/learn/locales/<locale>/topics/<slug>.json et revient aux modules anglais de src/content/learn quand une langue n’a pas encore de fichier. L’interface de ces pages est traduite. Les guides et les longues pages TSX de /learn/drbl et /learn/salary restent en anglais.

Artikeltexte werden aus Sprachdateien unter src/content/learn/locales/<locale>/topics/<slug>.json geladen und fallen auf die englischen Module in src/content/learn zurück, wenn eine Sprache noch keine Datei hat. Die Oberfläche dieser Seiten ist übersetzt. Leitfäden und die langen TSX-Seiten unter /learn/drbl und /learn/salary sind weiterhin englisch.
LearnPages.war1ZeroBody: Null ist ein durchschnittlicher Spieler. Ein Kader, dessen Spieler zusammen etwa 0 WAR1 ergeben, hat wie ein Team mit 40 Siegen gespielt. Jedes WAR1 entsprach etwa 1,3 echten Siegen. Team-WAR1-Summen sind keine Vorhersage der Siege in der Tabelle.
LearnPages.bodyEnglishNote: Dieser Artikel wird auf Englisch angezeigt. Die Übersetzung für deine Sprache wird noch ergänzt.

LearnPages.contentGapNote: O corpo dos artigos é carregado de arquivos por idioma em src/content/learn/locales/<locale>/topics/<slug>.json e volta aos módulos em inglês de src/content/learn quando um idioma ainda não tem arquivo. A interface dessas rotas está traduzida. Os guias e as páginas longas em TSX de /learn/drbl e /learn/salary continuam em inglês.

문서 본문은 src/content/learn/locales/<locale>/topics/<slug>.json 언어별 파일에서 불러오고, 해당 언어 파일이 아직 없으면 src/content/learn의 영어 모듈로 대체됩니다. 이 경로의 화면 요소는 번역되어 있습니다. 가이드와 /learn/drbl, /learn/salary의 긴 TSX 페이지는 아직 영어입니다.
記事本文は src/content/learn/locales/<locale>/topics/<slug>.json の言語別ファイルから読み込み、その言語のファイルがまだない場合は src/content/learn の英語モジュールを使います。これらのページの画面部品は翻訳済みです。ガイドと /learn/drbl、/learn/salary の長い TSX ページはまだ英語です。
文章正文从 src/content/learn/locales/<locale>/topics/<slug>.json 的语言文件加载，某语言还没有文件时回退到 src/content/learn 中的英文模块。这些页面的界面文字已翻译。指南以及 /learn/drbl 和 /learn/salary 的长篇 TSX 页面仍为英文。
文章內文從 src/content/learn/locales/<locale>/topics/<slug>.json 的語言檔載入，某語言還沒有檔案時會回退到 src/content/learn 中的英文模組。這些頁面的介面文字已翻譯。指南以及 /learn/drbl 和 /learn/salary 的長篇 TSX 頁面仍為英文。
